card.title: Pass Me the Authority
card.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before leaving the meeting, name me as the person who decides.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To the room, please. I already agree.

beats.text: Before leaving the meeting, name me as the person who decides.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To the room, please. I already agree.

mechanism: A demands an audible public succession statement rather than a chair or private acknowledgment.
confusable: Unlike claiming status alone, A must get the departing authority to name the transfer to others.
comparison: D60-b changes the audience of the statement; D60-a changes a symbolic key handover into a public decision exchange.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
